excludedBlocks.header: Loaded automatically on every page from /nav; authors never insert it.
excludedBlocks.footer: Loaded automatically on every page from /footer; authors never insert it.
excludedBlocks.widget: Needs widget code under /widgets/, which this site does not ship.

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: Expandable question-and-answer list. One row per item: the question in the first cell, the answer in the second.

cards.name: Cards
cards.description: Grid of cards. One row per card: an image cell and a text cell (heading, copy, optional link).

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.description: Full-bleed image slideshow with a frosted copy overlay, arrows, dots and autoplay. One row per slide: an image cell and a copy cell (title, lead, price, text, CTA).

variants.thumbnails: Adds a thumbnail rail under the slides. Use on product pages.

columns.name: Columns
columns.description: Side-by-side content. One row, one cell per column; a cell holding only an image becomes an image column.

variants.culture: Brand text column next to a media column, with PULSE type and spacing.
variants.schedule-layout: Narrative and image on the left, a schedule list on the right.

contactform.name: Contact form
contactform.description: Builds a form from a list. One cell: a heading, then one line per field ("Label | type" or "Label | select | option 1, option 2"), then the submit label. The form does not submit anywhere yet.

filterbar.name: Filter bar
filterbar.description: Product filter pills and a sort label above a product grid. One row: a list of filters in the first cell, the sort label in the second.

fragment.name: Fragment
fragment.description: Includes another page (for example a shared promo) in place. One cell with a link to the fragment path; replace the sample link with a real fragment.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: Page-opening banner with heading, copy and call to action over or next to an image.

variants.center-hero: Centred heading and copy with no side image.
variants.drop: Adds an orange pill badge above the heading (product launches).
variants.split: Two columns: text in the first cell, media in the second.
variants.backdrop: Image behind the text as a full backdrop.

locations.name: Locations
locations.description: Store or office locations. One row per location: image, city, locale code (for example en-US), address, phone.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Email sign-up band. One row: heading and copy in the first cell, the email placeholder and button text in the second. The form does not submit anywhere yet.

pdp.name: Product detail
pdp.description: Product detail hero: image gallery on the left; badges, title, price, description, colour and size options, add to cart and shipping note on the right.

productgrid.name: Product grid
productgrid.description: Grid of product cards. One row per product: image, name, price, tagline, CTA link. The first card is highlighted in brand blue.

variants.related: Related-products grid: no highlighted first card. Use at the foot of product pages.

scenarios.name: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Numbered lifestyle scenarios. One row per scenario: number and title, a one-line summary, the detail, and a link label.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Timed agenda. One row per slot: the time in the first cell, the detail in the second. Must be a top-level block; it is not decorated inside another block.

search.name: Search
search.description: Site search box and results, filtered as the visitor types. Use once, on the /search page. Leave the cell empty to search the whole site, or put a link to another index (for example /products/query-index.json).

specs.name: Specs
specs.description: Technical specification list for a product. One row per spec: label and value.

stats.name: Stats
stats.description: Headline figures. One row per figure: the number with its unit (for example 500K+ USERS), then a short caption.

testimonials.name: Testimonials
testimonials.description: Customer quotes as cards. One row per quote: optional avatar, the quote, and the name.

variants.reviews: Review cards with the author on top and star ratings. Use on product pages.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Brand milestones in order. One row per milestone: the year, a title, and the story.

ugcgrid.name: UGC grid
ugcgrid.description: Grid of customer posts (user-generated content). One row per post: image, social handle, caption.

valuecards.name: Value cards
valuecards.description: Brand values as cards. One row per value: an icon glyph (emoji or text), a title and a short body.

section-metadata.name: Section metadata
section-metadata.description: Styles the section it sits in. Put it at the end of a section. Styles: surface, pulse-pad, pulse-pad-lg, light, dark, blue, blue-tint, highlight, center (combine with commas).

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.description: Page title and description for search engines and social sharing. One per page, at the very end.
example: One or two sentences that describe the page.
